pie: sweh₂dú médʰu dʰh₁sṓm swéh₂dos. kʷéroy m̥lités ǵn̥h₁yéth₂e. priHóm te deywṓs wiHrṓs-kʷe píph₃onti. túH méǵh₂s n̥mr̥tṓm mówdos. nu deywóybʰos pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm séykʷomes. nu te pl̥h₁nóybʰos péh₃tloybʰos péh₃omes.
english: Sweet mead, delight of the deities! You were born from honey in the cauldron. Gods and men drink you, dear one. You are the great joy of the immortals. Now let us pour the first share for the gods. Then let us drink you from full cups.

pie: n̥mr̥tóybʰos néwom h₁erkʷóm séngʷʰomes. kéh₂nmn̥ nos sweh₂dú priHóm-kʷe. déywōs nos h₁h₃sés wékʷos ḱluté. h₁nómn̥-ge wos ḱlutóm ḱléwos wos méǵh₂. gʷéHyontey wiHrṓy h₁wésu ḱléwos dh₃té.
english: We sing a new hymn to the immortals. Our song is sweet and dear. Gods, hear the word of our mouth! Your name indeed is famous; your fame is great. Give good fame to the man who sings.

pie: bʰáge némesh₁ tetr̥pdʰí. tébʰye-ge sélpos h₁éwsome. tébʰye néwom médʰu sikʷmé. nu némos h₁áyso h₁wésuh₂-kʷe nos dh₃dʰí.
english: Bhagos, be satisfied with the sacrifice. For you indeed we burned fat. For you we poured out the new mead. Now take the sacrifice and give us good things.

pie: h₂éydʰosyo-ge dn̥ǵʰwéh₂s h₁rudʰréh₂. sélpos léyǵʰti mḗms gʷr̥h₃éti. tósyo kr̥snós dʰuh₂mós úd bʰérǵʰt. déywōs dʰuh₂móm h₃édonti gʷm̥yónti-kʷe. h₁n̥gʷnís n̥mr̥tóybʰos dʰégʷʰoyh₁t.
english: The tongue of the fire indeed is red. It licks the fat; it devours the meat. Its black smoke rises upward. The gods smell the smoke and come. May Fire burn for the immortals.

pie: gʷṓm h₂éyeri h₂ml̥ǵdʰí. h₂mélǵos ph₂wéni gʷʰr̥nudʰí. gʷʰermóm h₁íd péh₂wr̥ h₁n̥dó liHdʰí. ḱunéy loypéh₂m dh₃dʰí.
english: Milk the cow at dawn. Heat the milk at the fire. Pour it warm into the fire. Give the remainder to the dog.

pie: h₂éyeri sth₂dʰí swóh₁-kʷe ǵʰóstoh₁ léwh₃e. h₂sowsóm dóru h₂Hséh₂i dʰh₁dʰí. péh₂wr̥ h₂idʰdʰí h₁íd-kʷe gʷr̥nHdʰí. h₁yód léwkt h₁erkʷóm gʷéHye. nu h₃éngʷn̥ péh₂wr̥ h₁n̥dó ǵʰudʰí.
english: At dawn stand up and wash your hands. Put dry wood on the fire-altar. Kindle the fire and praise it. When it has become bright, sing the hymn. Then pour butter into the fire.

pie: nu nos h₂Hséh₂s h₁ń̥gʷney démi sedéh₁yesi. h₂ŕ̥ǵre ǵérh₂ontn̥s téḱneh₂-kʷe gʷʰr̥néwsi. mā́dsom nos pékʷesi nékʷti nos péh₂si. h₃éngʷn̥ toy h₂sowsóm-kʷe dóru dedh₃més. mē mérs léwke h₂éydʰe h₂ŕ̥ǵre.
english: Now, Fire of the hearth, you sit in our house. You heat the old men and the children, shining one. You cook our food; in the night you guard us. We give you butter and dry wood. Do not die, bright fire, shining one!

pie: nu h₁n̥gʷním h₂yuHn̥ḱóm deywóm gʷr̥nHmés. h₂sowsóy dréwi ǵn̥h₁yéto nékʷti-kʷe h₂wékst. nu dyḗm bʰérǵʰt h₁ésyo bʰéh₂os wiHróybʰos léwkt. n̥mr̥tṓs widónt mudént-kʷe. dl̥h₁gʰóm h₂óyu démi dʰégʷʰoyh₁t.
english: Now we praise Fire, the young god. He was born in the dry wood, and he grew in the night. Then he rose up to the sky; his light became bright for men. The immortals saw and rejoiced. May he burn in the house for a long lifetime.

pie: h₂Hséh₂s péh₂wr̥ h₂lékse. nékʷti mē mr̥yéh₁t. h₁íd wékʷsperoy stége. néwoybʰos dóru h₂éyeri h₁ésmi h₁épi dʰh₁dʰí. h₁yód méreti néwom péh₂wr̥ h₃rēǵés ḱóymoy h₂isḱé. h₁íd ḱóymom kʷéroh₁ bʰére.
english: Protect the fire of the hearth. Let it not die in the night. In the evening cover it. At dawn put new wood on it. If it dies, seek new fire in the household of the king. Carry it home in a pot.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: h₁yós ǵʰéwdeti só deywóybʰos pr̥h₂wóm péh₃tlom déh₃eti. nu ǵérh₂onts píph₃ēti nu h₂yuHn̥ḱṓs srobʰéyōnti. h₁yós ne séykʷeti pérkʷunos tóm mē ḱléwsoyh₁t.
english: Whoever pours, let him give the first cup to the gods. Then let the old man drink; then let the young men sip. Whoever does not pour, may Perkunos not listen to him.

pie: nu moy h₂éwsos suHnúm dh₃dʰí. ḱuh₁rós ǵn̥h₃rós ḱlutós-kʷe h₁syéh₁t. h₁ésyo-kʷe ḱléwos méǵh₂ h₁syéh₁t. nu tébʰye sweh₂dú médʰu ǵʰḗm.
english: Now, Dawn, give me a son! May he be strong and wise and famous. And may his fame be great. Now I have poured the sweet mead for you.

pie: dyéw nos ph₂ter h₁erkʷóm ḱludʰí. tébʰye-ge médʰu léyHomes. tébʰye-ge sélpos h₁éwsōmes. ph₂ter wiHrṓm dʰéh₁leh₂ upér spéḱyesi. pl̥th₂enéh₂i dʰǵʰémi h₂wr̥sdʰí. ǵr̥h₂nóm nos h₂uksyéh₁t péḱu-kʷe nos h₂uksyéh₁t.
english: Father Sky, hear our hymn! To you indeed let us pour the mead. To you indeed let us burn the fat. Father, you look upon the deeds of men from above. Rain upon the wide earth! Let our grain grow, and let our livestock grow.

pie: sédesh₂ ph₂wéni péri str̥h₃dʰí. deywṓs h₂én sedéh₁yonti. tóysōm sédesu mē séds. péh₃tleh₂ sédesu h₂énti stn̥h₂dʰí. téh₂ h₂mélǵesh₁ pl̥nh₁dʰí.
english: Spread the seats around the fire. There the gods sit. Do not sit down on their seats. Set the cups in front of the seats. Fill them with milk.

pie: swóh₁ ǵʰóstoh₁ nigʷdʰí nu ǵʰutéh₂ ǵʰuddʰí. sóh₂wl̥ próti mē h₃méyǵʰes déh₂nu-wē h₁n̥dó mē h₃méyǵʰes. h₂éHsh₂m̥ upér mē gʷéms. h₁yós ḱéh₂ dʰéh₁leh₂ dʰédʰeh₁eti pérkʷunos tósmey gʰrémeti.
english: Wash your hands; then pour the libation. Do not urinate toward the sun, nor into the river. Do not step over the hearth. Whoever does these deeds, Perkunos is angry at him.

pie: moysóm gʷoh₂móm wédʰe. h₁ím ḱéstroh₁ skl̥Hdʰí. h₁ésyo h₁ésh₂r̥ dʰǵʰémi sikʷdʰí. mḗms gʷrúsu pékʷe. dʰh₁séy pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm dh₃dʰí sélpos-kʷe ph₂wéni h₁éwse. nu h₁léwdʰeyes mḗms h₁édonti.
english: Lead the ram to the altar. Slit it open with the knife. Pour out its blood on the earth. Cook the meat on spits. Give the first share to the god, and burn the fat in the fire. Then let the people eat the meat.

pie: wékʷsperos gʷémt sóh₂wl̥-kʷe séngʷt. nu-kʷe h₂ŕ̥ǵre dṓm nékʷti lowkéyesi. kr̥snéh₂m nos nókʷtm̥ pér ph₂sdʰí. wĺ̥kʷom-kʷe nos h₂óweyes h₂epó h₂éǵe. h₃éngʷn̥ h₂éyeri ǵʰéwomes.
english: Evening has come, and the sun has sunk. And now, shining one, you light up the house in the night. Guard us through the dark night. And drive the wolf away from our sheep. At dawn let us pour the butter.

pie: h₁yód deywṓs h₂ḱh₃ént mḗms h₁édomes. médʰu píph₃ōmes kéh₂nmn̥h₂-kʷe séngʷʰōmes. ǵérh₂ontes swṓm ph₂trṓm spéleh₂ wérh₁onti. h₁yós luǵrós h₁ésti só méwdeti.
english: When the gods have eaten, let us eat the meat. Let us drink the mead and sing the songs. Let the old men tell the stories of their fathers. Whoever is sad, let him become glad.

pie: nu nos ń̥mr̥tōs déywōs dh₂pnóm gʷm̥té. sédesh₂ str̥h₃mé sweh₂dú médʰu ǵʰumé. sdté ǵéwsete méwdete-kʷe. h₁yós wos ǵʰéwdeti tósmey h₁wésuh₂ dh₃té.
english: Now come, immortal gods, to our feast! We have spread the seats, we have poured the sweet mead. Sit down, taste, and rejoice! Whoever pours for you, to him give good things.

pie: awis akwāsas ka.
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: nu toy h₂ŕ̥ǵre h₂mélǵos ǵʰumé. léwke gʷʰermóm h₂mélǵos ph₃dʰí. gʷówes polh₁éwes kéh₂ilōs-kʷe h₁sih₁ént.
english: Now we have poured milk for you, shining one. Drink the warm milk, bright one. May the cows be many and healthy.

pie: h₃rḗḱs súHnum wl̥nh₁to.
english: The king wanted a son.

pie: nébʰtew h₂ékʷeh₂s pótey ḱludʰí. tébʰye gʷʰermóm h₂mélǵos sikʷmé. h₁yós déh₂newi tḱéysi dóh₃r̥ nos h₁áyso. péḱu nos toy h₂ékʷeh₂m píph₃oyh₁t. suHnúns nos déh₂newi mē h₁éps.
english: Nebhtus, master of the water, hear! To you we have poured the warm milk. You who dwell in the river, receive our gift. May our livestock drink your water. Do not seize our sons in the river.

pie: h₂éydʰe dʰégʷʰe léwke dʰégʷʰe. dṓm nos ph₂sdʰí h₁ím mē h₁éwses. h₂sowsóm dóru h₁éwse lukdʰí.
english: Burn, fire; burn, bright one! Guard our house; do not burn it! Burn the dry wood; become bright!

pie: dʰh₁sbʰós pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm ǵʰéwdoh₂. médʰu pl̥h₁nṓd péh₃tlōd péh₃oh₂. médʰu-kʷe nos h₁h₃sú sweh₂dú h₁syéh₁t.
english: Let me pour the first share for the god. Let me drink the mead from the full cup. And may the mead be sweet in our mouths.

pie: mélit wódr̥-kʷe kʷéroy dʰh₁dʰí. kʷérom ph₂wéni gʷʰr̥nudʰí. tríns dinóns yésēti. nu médʰu ǵʰuddʰí. pr̥h₂wóm péh₃tlom mē píph₃es dʰh₁séy tód dh₃dʰí.
english: Put honey and water in the cauldron. Heat the cauldron at the fire. Let it boil for three days. Then pour the mead. Do not drink the first cup; give it to the god.

pie: nu nos h₂éydʰe póyḱons h₁éwse. tóysōm dṓm dʰégʷʰe tóysōm h₂éǵrons dʰégʷʰe. mē nos widóyh₁ent nu nos h₁léwdʰins h₂lékse.
english: Now, fire, burn our enemies! Burn their house, burn their fields. May they not see us; now protect our people.

pie: nu ph₂wéni h₁épi légʰm̥. nu me léwke nékʷti ph₂sdʰí. póyḱos nos ḱóymom mē gʷm̥yéh₁t. h₂ŕ̥ǵre te h₂éyeri h₂éydʰoh₂.
english: Now I have lain down near the fire. Now, bright one, guard me in the night. May the enemy not come to our village. At dawn let me kindle you, shining one.
